title: The Builder
intro: I build local-first software: tools that run on your machine, keep your data there, and put AI agents to work on real projects. Most of it is TypeScript and Rust, with some C++ and C# when the target is a VR headset.

principles.name: Local-first by default
principles.text: State lives in SQLite on the user's machine. Nothing leaves unless they send it.

principles.name: Agents do the work, people approve it
principles.text: Claude Code runs headless, behind gates a person controls.

principles.name: Ship the whole thing
principles.text: Desktop app, backend, observability and the site that explains it.
